brand_identity.name: Outdooroots
brand_identity.logo_style: Wordmark only ('Outdooroots'), no invented logos or unverified badges
brand_identity.visual_tone: Light-and-airy editorial presentation, elegant serif headings, deep blue accents, authentic destination photography, restrained motion. Premium presentation across all price points (not luxury-only).

typography.tech_stack_note: Frontend components are JavaScript (.js) files, not TypeScript (.tsx)

scale.section_heading: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight

i18n_and_currency.currency_rules: All public traveler estimates are displayed in EUR (€). No automatic currency toggle on public screens. Team pipeline uses CLP internally for cost calculations and converts to EUR using dated rate.

three_starting_signatures.focus: Trekking, glaciers, and iconic granite horns in Torres del Paine
High-altitude salt flats, geysers, and celestial night skies
Volcano views, ancient temperate rainforests, and Chiloé folklore

five_regions_editable_order.name_es: Región de los Lagos y Chiloé

commercial_pricing_rules.calculation_basis: Honest illustrative estimate with transparent per-item itemization.
rules: No blanket base fees or 19% automatic tax applied to public estimates.
Shared costs (transfers, private guides) billed per party, not multiplied per traveler.
Lodge accommodations and per-person activities billed per guest.
Complex custom or large group requests show 'Quote Required upon review'.

features: Internal cost calculation in CLP with dated CLP/EUR FX conversion rate.
Configurable agency margin % and explicit tax fees.
Private margin and internal notes strictly stripped from public exports and PDFs.
Analytics dashboard with stage distribution, overdue follow-ups, conversion rate, and requested budget insights.

one_page_downloadable_summary.format: Typeset downloadable PDF summary / print view
required_sections: Traveler & Brief Overview (Name, Party Size, Dates, Experience Type)
Day-by-Day Timeline Digest with Regional Chapters
Important Disclaimer: 'Illustrative proposal - subject to final team verification & availability'

instructions_to_main_agent: Verify all React components use JavaScript (.js) files.
Ensure language toggle switches smoothly between English (en) and Spanish (es) without resetting builder state.
Implement the three signature starting paths in Home.js / Builder.js.
Maintain the progressive brief modal/form with responsive mobile support.
Render day-by-day timeline with duration checks, activity slots, and downtime indicators.
Implement downloadable one-page PDF summary and team inquiry pipeline in Admin.js.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, and interactive elements.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Maintain strict optical alignment and generous vertical padding (p-6, p-8, p-12).
Ensure high contrast compliance on light warm background (#FDFBF7) with deep navy text (#0B192C) and dark muted gray (#5C656E).
All interactive elements must have visible focus, hover, and press states with smooth CSS transitions.

Never rely on complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that have content scrolling beneath them. Use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque background (e.g., bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 backdrop-blur-md).

All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='signature-card-patagonia', data-testid='language-toggle-es', data-testid='export-pdf-button').
